stories.title: Carburanti ancora in rialzo, il diesel si avvicina a 2,5 euro in autostrada. È polemica su tetto Eni

en.title: Fuel prices continue rising, diesel approaches 2.5 euros on motorways. Controversy over Eni ceiling
en.summary: Diesel prices on Italian roads reached 2.377 euros per liter and petrol 2.159 euros, with long queues expected at Eni stations tomorrow. Small fuel distributors claim unfair competition from the price cap.

stories.title: Bimbo investito a Torino, è stata l'ex compagna del padre

en.title: Child hit by car in Turin, identified as father's ex-partner
en.summary: A young child was struck by a vehicle in Turin yesterday evening. The child's father identified the driver as his former partner. The child is in serious condition but not in life-threatening danger.

stories.title: Centinaia di manifestanti accampati in Puerta del Sol a Madrid per diritto alla casa

en.title: Hundreds of protesters camped at Puerta del Sol in Madrid demanding housing rights
en.summary: Peaceful protesters occupied Madrid's Puerta del Sol overnight to press for approval of the housing decree known as 'decreto Maricarmen'.

stories.title: Il Papa in Francia, la Messa a Lourdes: "Gli abusi sono una piaga, ci sia massima vigilanza"

en.title: Pope in France, Mass at Lourdes: "Abuse is a scourge, maximum vigilance required"
en.summary: The Pope celebrated Mass at the Lourdes shrine before approximately 150,000 people and later met with abuse victims. His French visit drew large crowds, particularly young people, and received widespread positive media coverage.

stories.title: Tensione alla marcia in Irlanda del Nord, folla protesta contro parata Orange

en.title: Tension at march in Northern Ireland, crowd protests against Orange parade
en.summary: Crowds protested against an Orange parade in Northern Ireland, prompting the UK Prime Minister to call for calm.

stories.title: Il Papa a Lourdes tra i malati. E oggi riceve le vittime degli abusi dei preti: “Piaga dolorosa”

en.title: Pope at Lourdes among the sick. And today he receives victims of priest abuse: "Painful scourge"
en.summary: The Pope visited Lourdes to meet with French bishops and received seven survivors of clerical abuse, emphasizing the need for vigilance against such crimes.

stories.title: Gran Bretagna, allarme esplosivi vicino a una base della RAF usata dagli Usa per operazioni in Iran: “Diversi arresti”

en.title: Great Britain, explosives alert near RAF base used by US for operations in Iran: "Several arrests"
en.summary: Authorities discovered explosives near a Royal Air Force base in Whelford used by the US military, leading to evacuations and arrests.

stories.title: Carburanti ancora in rialzo, diesel si avvicina a 2,5 euro in autostrada

en.title: Fuels still rising, diesel approaches 2.5 euros on highway
en.summary: Fuel prices continued to increase, with diesel nearing 2.5 euros per liter on Italian highways.

stories.title: Gran Bretagna, allarme esplosivi vicino a una base della RAF usata dagli Usa: arresti ed evacuazioni

en.title: Britain, explosives alert near RAF base used by US: arrests and evacuations
en.summary: Explosives were discovered near a RAF base in the Whelford area used by the United States, prompting military bomb disposal experts to examine vehicles and local residents to be evacuated to a recreational center.

stories.title: L'accampamento dopo la manifestazione: la protesta a Madrid per il diritto alla casa

en.title: The encampment after the demonstration: the protest in Madrid for the right to housing
en.summary: Protesters advocating for housing rights in Madrid established an encampment following a large march through the city.

stories.title: Irlanda del Nord, tensione altissima: catene umane di cattolici contro una marcia protestante

en.title: Northern Ireland, very high tension: human chains of Catholics against a Protestant march
en.summary: A controversial Orange parade on a republican street in Garvaghy Road was approved after 28 years of bans and overnight legal proceedings, with Catholics forming human chains to block the route and risking confrontations with Protestant marchers.

stories.title: La diretta della messa di Papa Leone dal Santuario di Nostra Signora di Lourdes

en.title: Live broadcast of Pope Leo's mass from the Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
en.summary: Pope Leo celebrated mass at the Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes in France, with approximately 200,000 people expected to attend his two-day visit and over 7,000 sick pilgrims registered for the service.

stories.title: Halloween, è iniziato il conto alla rovescia per la notte dei fantasmi

en.title: Halloween, the countdown has begun for the night of ghosts
en.summary: Halloween-themed attractions featuring zombies, ghosts, skeletons, vampires, witches, monsters and pumpkins are populating theme parks during October as the All Saints' Day tradition gains prominence.

stories.title: «Regate in mezzo al publico come mai, Luna Rossa e New Zealand i team favoriti»

en.title: Races in the middle of the public like never before, Luna Rossa and New Zealand the favorite teams
en.summary: Francesco de Angelis describes the atmosphere in Naples and sailing conditions for preliminary races, with Luna Rossa and New Zealand positioned as competition favorites.

stories.title: Consolato americano a Milano, la società americana risarcisce i lavoratori con 30 milioni

en.title: American Consulate in Milan, American company compensates workers with 30 million
en.summary: Following a labor exploitation investigation by prosecutors, Caddell has reached a settlement agreement with a court-appointed administrator regarding worker compensation.

stories.title: Musica, la lotta ai bot che rubano ascolti e compensi agli artisti

en.title: Music, the fight against bots that steal streams and earnings from artists
en.summary: Music industry stakeholders are addressing the problem of bot-driven artificial streaming that defrauds artists of legitimate compensation and undermines sector integrity.

stories.title: A Napoli alberghi occupati al 100%, ma la provincia resta esclusa

en.title: In Naples hotels at 100% occupancy, but the province remains excluded
en.summary: Naples hotels achieved full occupancy during a preliminary regatta event, demonstrating strong city appeal. However, the surrounding province did not benefit equally from the increased tourism activity.
